mapper.select: SELECT u.*, o.org_name AS orgName FROM agri_md_user u LEFT JOIN agri_md_organization o ON u.org_id = o.id WHERE u.id = #{id} AND u.del_flag = 0
SELECT role_id FROM agri_md_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT r.role_name FROM agri_md_user_role ur JOIN agri_md_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.del_flag = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agri_md_user_role (user_id, role_id, tenant_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, #{tenantId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agri_md_user WHERE username = #{username} AND del_flag = 0
SELECT * FROM agri_md_user WHERE phone = #{phone} AND del_flag = 0
SELECT * FROM agri_md_user WHERE email = #{email} AND del_flag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE agri_md_user SET last_login_time = #{loginTime}, last_login_ip = #{loginIp}, login_count = login_count + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{userId} AND del_flag = 0
UPDATE agri_md_user SET user_status = #{userStatus}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{userId} AND del_flag = 0
UPDATE agri_md_user SET real_name_status = #{realNameStatus}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{userId} AND del_flag = 0
